purpose: Teach: 胴/天地/断層/母語/鉱業/私生活/積雪/雌

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、人体の胴体構造研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote that paper on human torso anatomy, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, encouraging tone. Slightly leadingly phrased — she's checking in on him. Calm but attentive. Gentle reset of attention toward him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、神話における天地創造の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I actually wrote about creation myths and cosmogony.
lines.style: Quiet correction, not defensive. A bit flustered — caught off-guard that she was looking at something different. Sincere underneath. Trails slightly, uncertain if he's explaining enough.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、地震断層の調査研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, didn't you write about earthquake fault surveys?
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuinely curious. A beat of silence before speaking — she's working through something. Not quite matching what she expected. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、母語習得の発達心理学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—actually, my paper was on developmental psychology of native language acquisition.
lines.style: Quiet, earnest correction. A touch of vulnerability — he's clarifying again. Doesn't sound irritated, just sincere. Small pause before answering, gathering himself.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 近代日本の鉱業発展史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So you covered the industrial development of modern Japan?
lines.style: Engaged, following along but still slightly off. Sincere attempt to track with him. A questioning lilt at the end — opening space for him to speak again.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、芸能人の私生活と健康を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—my actual topic was on celebrity private life and health impacts.
lines.style: Patient, kind correction without edge. Used to this pattern. Soft steadiness in his voice. Not embarrassed, just gently redirecting. Small smile underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、山岳地帯の積雪量変動を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you examined snowfall variation in mountainous regions?
lines.style: Reflective, still working through the disconnect. Not quite landing. Genuine curiosity in her voice, but a touch of puzzlement. Slower pace, giving him space.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、ミツバチの雌の役割研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes—I actually researched the role of female honeybees in the colony.
lines.style: Quiet, steady correction. He's used to this now. Soft finality in his tone — last answer. No edge, just genuine. Small resolve underneath the earnestness.
